description: Lists the songs an account has chosen to publish on its profile, newest first, with cursor pagination. `hasAudio` and `audioPlayable` are only ever true between accounts that follow each other MUTUALLY: without that link the very existence of a backing track is withheld, and no endpoint serves audio at all. A private account you do not follow refuses the call; an unknown handle returns not-found. Consumes one unit of the daily read quota.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim.

handle.description: Public username of the account, with or without the leading "@".

name: jj_list_profile_songs
title: List songs published by an account
